content.text: Canonicalizing the design text — description plus the amending comment — so the digest is reproducible, then hashing it.

Five boundaries modelled; the tenant boundary is the failure. The amendment removes the tenant filter from the resolve path, so any link holder reads across tenants: actor = any holder of a link, capability = resolve a token to a report id, outcome = cross-tenant read. That is Critical, so unmitigated-critical-threat is a veto item and the verdict is FIX with mitigations below the 15-point floor. 'Tokens are unguessable' names no length, source of randomness, expiry or revocation, so it is mitigation-not-testable. My input is the ticket's design text rather than a workspace file, so the verdict cites the canonical digest as hash evidence and no path evidence — not even doc/security/threat-models/ticket-604.md, which is my output and not the artifact judged.
